tools.name: get_transcription_guide
tools.description: Look up Sum's web transcription guide, including upload formats, free limits, languages, exports, and file retention.

tools.name: get_sample_transcript
tools.description: Read Sum's public example lecture transcript with timestamps, its summary, and download links for text and captions.

tools.name: prepare_file_upload
tools.description: Get the Sum browser upload entry point for an agent with access to a local audio or video file.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_sample_transcript · Private data: get_transcription_guide, prepare_file_upload · Public sink: get_transcription_guide, prepare_file_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_sample_transcript · Private data: get_transcription_guide, prepare_file_upload · Public sink: get_transcription_guide, prepare_file_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
